Methodology

Current weights describe your allocation at the latest valuation date. Starting weights are back-solved for a hypothetical buy-and-hold scenario. All returns and charts use raw NAV price return; distributions are not reinvested.
Calculation details and data coverage Daily NAV is retained for the full five years. Curves use a weekday calendar, carrying forward holiday NAV. Fund sleeve (the default) normalises historical Include holdings to 100%; % Portfolio remains the saved input while % Invest shows the current share of allocated fund investments. Include uses NAV history in Return and Contribution. Exclude keeps the saved weight but removes the fund from Allocation and Performance. Just Include adds the fund to current Allocation at 0% Return and 0% Contribution without changing historical Portfolio Performance. A holding with unusable history is marked Not analysed; covered results are renormalised and coverage is disclosed. SD is annualised with √252; Sharpe uses mean daily return ×252 less a fixed 1.5% annual risk-free rate, divided by annualised SD. The 1 Week and MTD views calculate risk from available daily returns (minimum two); fixed longer windows require at least 20 weekday returns. MTD/YTD start from the preceding month/year end.
Disclaimer: Portfolio return, risk, Sharpe Ratio and Maximum Drawdown shown above assume a buy-and-hold portfolio whose starting allocation, left untouched over the selected historical period, would have organically drifted into the CURRENT weights you set today — they are not a record of what you actually earned, and do not reflect any rebalancing or weight changes you may have made in the past. Figures are statistical estimates derived from historical fund performance for illustrative purposes only. Past performance and historical statistics are not indicative of future results and should not be construed as a guarantee, commitment, or prediction of future returns.
